decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (PL 02 A received 27.06.12
PL 03 E and PL 04 B received 07.08.12
Tech Spec - Grease Bloc, Catalogue Images of Filters, Kitchen Flow Rates, Carbon Filters, Fan figures received 07.08.12.
Layout of extraction system received 28.09.12.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 8.00 hours and 23.30 hours, Mondays to Fridays and 09.30 hours and 23.00 hours on Sundays.
Condition : 5 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 07.00 to 18.00 nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises, and shall not extend to the delivery of food or drink to customers by vehicle.

Condition : 7 - The kitchen extract system shall be provided, before the use is brought into operation, and when at maximum operation shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:
a) A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the building.
b) The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one metre above eaves level or one metre above openable windows of nearby properties.
c) The ducting shall be circular.
d) The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.
e) The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.
f) The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.
g) The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.

Condition : 8 - Prior to occupation the development shall provide an access doorway with a minimum clear opening width of 900mm, level access within the site and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Change of use from existing A1 unit to proposed A3 use with incorporation of kitchen extraction system and additions to the rear.
